excludedSourceReferences: Creator-owned introductory recommendations: Buzzkill, God Country, Redneck and Babyteeth are outside this Marvel sequence.
Related reading orders for Jonathan Hickman and Brian Michael Bendis are navigation, not source rows.
Secret Empire and Marvel Legacy are contextual links, not numbered selections.
Doctor Strange by Donny Cates collection overview names the same issues whose proper reading order is explicitly printed below it; follow that interleaving once, not a second collection pass.
The complete Damnation guide is a pointer; only the four Damnation issues explicitly interleaved here are selected.
Infinity Countdown and Infinity Wars contextual links do not expand the explicit Infinity Wars Prime #1 and Thanos Legacy #1 pair.
War of the Realms core event and Thor: God of Thunder are contextual pointers without numbered selections. Venom #13-16 remains in the source sequence.
Absolute Carnage is an unnumbered collection and dedicated-guide pointer. The existing absolute-carnage catalog checklist remains separate; no core issues or tie-ins are recursively inserted.
